decision.trust.label: Ukuthembeka
decision.trust.description: Zonke ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi okunqunywa ngendlela eqinile kudlulile. Isiphumo singangethemba ngaphansi kokuhlolwa kwansuku zonke.
decision.trust.next_action: Isiphumo singangena emsebenzini wezokwelapha ngaphansi kokuqapheliswa kwansuku zonke.
decision.trust.can_rely: Yebo, kungaqhubeka ngaphansi kokuhlolwa kwansuku zonke.
decision.review.label: Ukubuyekezwa
decision.review.description: Kutholakale izinkinga zomongo. Kufanele i-operateri eqeqeshiwe ibuyekeze ubufakazi ngaphambi kokuthemba isiphumo.
decision.review.next_action: Yima ukuze i-operateri eqeqeshiwe ibuyekeze; hlola imongo ebhalwe ngaphambi kokuthemba isiphumo.
decision.review.can_rely: Akukho okwamanje, kudingeka ukubuyekezwa yi-operateri eqeqeshiwe.
decision.verify.label: Ukuqinisekisa
decision.verify.description: Kutholakale ukwehluleka okucacile kwekhwalithi. Ungangethembi isiphumo ngasodwa, phinda futhi uqinisekise ngendlela enye.
driver.qc_failed.title: Ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi kwehlulekile
driver.qc_failed.explanation: Ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi kwedivayisi kwehlulekile, ngakho isiphumo asinakwazi ukwethenjwa ngaphandle kokuqinisekiswa.
driver.qc_failed.action: Ungangethembi lesi siphumo. Lungisa futhi uphinde ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi, bese uphinda uhlolo.
driver.cal_expired.title: I-calibration iphelelwe yisikhathi
driver.cal_expired.action: Ungangethemba lokhu kulinganisa kuze kuqalwe futhi i-calibration bese uhlolo luphindwa.
driver.cal_near_due.title: I-calibration iseduze nedethi
driver.reagent_expired.title: I-reagent iphelelwe yisikhathi
driver.reagent_expired.explanation: I-lot ye-reagent idlulile idethi yayo yokuphelelwa.
driver.reagent_expired.action: Shintsha i-lot ye-reagent bese uphinda uhlolo.
driver.reagent_near_expiry.title: I-reagent iseduze yokuphelelwa yisikhathi
driver.reagent_near_expiry.explanation: I-lot ye-reagent iseduze edethini yayo yokuphelelwa.
driver.reagent_near_expiry.action: Hlela ukushintsha i-lot ye-reagent ngaphambi kokuphelelwa yisikhathi.
driver.operator_not_competent.title: Ikhono le-operateri alisasesikhathini
driver.operator_not_competent.explanatio: Ikhono le-operateri obhalwe ngalo alisasesikhathini salo hlolo.
driver.operator_not_competent.action: I-operateri enekhono elisesikhathini kufanele ibuyekeze lesi siphumo bese iphinda uhlolo uma kudingeka.
driver.env_temp.title: Izinga lokushisa lingaphandle kobubanzi
driver.env_temp.explanation: Izinga lokushisa lomoya belingaphandle kobubanzi obuvumelekile ngesikhathi sohlolo.
driver.env_temp.action: Buyisela izinga lokushisa elivumelekile bese uphinda uhlolo uma kusala izinkinga.
driver.env_humidity.title: Umswakama ungaphandle kobubanzi
driver.env_humidity.explanation: Umswakama womoya belungaphandle kobubanzi obuvumelekile ngesikhathi sohlolo.
driver.env_humidity.action: Buyisela umswakama ovumelekile bese uphinda uhlolo uma kusala izinkinga.
driver.power_interruption.title: Ukuqhelekenyeka kombane kubhalwe
driver.power_interruption.explanation: Ukuqhelekenyeka kombane kubhalwe eduze ngesikhathi sohlolo.
driver.power_interruption.action: Qinisekisa ukuthi idivayisi iqede ukuhlolwa kwayo ngemva kokuqhelekenyeka; phinda uhlolo uma ungay iqinisekile.
driver.provenance_incomplete.title: Imvelaphi ayiphelele
driver.provenance_incomplete.explanation: Enye noma ngaphezulu yemininingwane yemvelaphi, i-operateri, i-lot ye-reagent noma indawo, ayibhalwanga.
driver.provenance_incomplete.action: Bhala imininingwane yemvelaphi edingekayo ngaphambi kokuthemba lesi siphumo.
driver.multi_context.title: Izinkinga zomongo eziningi
driver.multi_context.explanation: Izinkinga zomongo eziningi zisebenza ngesikhathi esisodwa kulesi siphumo.
driver.multi_context.action: Buyeza lezi zinkinga zihlangene ne-operateri eqeqeshiwe ngaphambi kokuthemba lesi siphumo.
driver.all_checks_pass.title: Zonke izinhlolo ziphumelele
driver.all_checks_pass.explanation: Zonke ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi okunqunywa ngendlela eqinile kudlulile.
driver.all_checks_pass.action: Akukho okudingekayo, qhubeka ngaphansi kokuhlolwa kwansuku zonke.

evidence.state.valid.label: Kulungile
evidence.state.valid.meaning: Ubufakazi bukhona futhi busesikhathini ngokwanele ngaphansi kwenqubomgomo yokubonisa ekhethiwe.
evidence.state.aging.label: Iyabudala
evidence.state.aging.meaning: Ubufakazi busalungile kodwa buseduze komkhawulo obekiwe wokubuyekezwa.
evidence.state.missing.label: Akutholakali
evidence.state.stale.label: Budala kakhulu
evidence.state.stale.meaning: Ubufakazi bukhona kodwa budala kakhulu ukusekela lolu hlelo ngokwethenjwa.
evidence.state.expired.label: Kuphelelwe yisikhathi
evidence.state.failed.label: Kwehlulekile
evidence.state.conflicting.label: Kuphikisana
evidence.state.conflicting.meaning: Imithombo yobufakazi iyaphikisana, noma ubufakazi abuhambelani ngaphakathi.
evidence.state.unverified-source.label: Umthombo ongaqinisekiswanga
evidence.state.unverified-source.meaning: Ubufakazi bukhona kodwa imvelaphi yabo ayikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa ngokwanele.
ui.app.tagline: Izinhlolo ezinqunywa ngendlela eqinile zinamandla · I-AI iseluleko kuphela.
ui.language.label: Ulimi
ui.language.supported_note: IsiNgisi yisisekelo esivamile. Ezinye izilimi ziyisiboniso ze zaqinisekiswa.
ui.ai.subtitle: Incazelo esizwa i-AI esisuselwa ebufakazini bekwalikhwalithi oburekhodiwe, iseluleko kuphela, ingaphansi kosinqumo osunqunywa ngendlela eqinile.
ui.ai.review_authoritative: Ukubuyekezwa kusahlala yisinqumo esigunyaziwe, le noto ayitshintshi lo sinqumo.
ui.ai.summary_only: Irekhoodi egciniwe igcina isifingqo seseluleko kuphela, awukho amanani okwethembeka noma igama lemodeli agciniwe kulolu hlelo.
ui.ai.unavailable: Ukuhlaziywa komongo akutholakali, isiphumo esinqunyiwe sigcinile. Akukho mphumela wokuphepha.
